page_coupling.note: Design 13 G1-G3 (docs/design_current/13_frontend_backend_separation.txt; docs/design_current/07_engineering_structure.txt restates the rule), frozen at stage S0b (2026-11-13). Per file that creates controls: store_access counts every store reference (<any expression>.store or .learning_store; a chain counts once), except a reference that is directly an argument of an owner_calls entry (never in a page package: arrangement/ui, admission/ui, home/ui, next_step/ui) or of id/isinstance/type; app_state counts distinct attribute names set on the app object (assignment, loop, with-as and setattr targets). Ceilings only fall: lower or remove an entry in the change that lowers the number. A file without an entry has ceiling zero; a page package (arrangement/ui, admission/ui, home/ui, next_step/ui) never has an entry.
